name: committee-pack
title: Accreditation committee pack: internal draft
for_each: select id,code from cycles order by code

sections.title: Standards and evidence
sections.sql: select code,standard,version,owner,valid_evidence,open_findings from evidence_matrix where cycle_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Visit reports
sections.sql: select code,lead,planned_on,completed_on,report_ref from visits where cycle_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Review team
sections.sql: select person,role,conflict_state,declared_on from assignments where cycle_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Committee decisions
sections.sql: select code,outcome,decision_on,committee,minute_ref,rationale from decisions where cycle_id=$1 order by decision_on,code

name: corrective-actions
title: Corrective action schedule: internal draft
for_each: select id,code from cycles order by code

sections.title: Actions and closure evidence
sections.sql: select f.code,f.title,f.owner,f.severity,f.due_on,f.status,f.resolution,f.verified_by,f.closed_on from findings f join requirements r on r.id=f.requirement_id where r.cycle_id=$1 order by f.code

name: renewal-brief
title: Renewal brief: internal draft
for_each: select id,code from cycles where renewal_on is not null order by code

sections.title: Standards and evidence
sections.sql: select code,standard,version,owner,valid_evidence,open_findings from evidence_matrix where cycle_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Committee decisions
sections.sql: select code,outcome,decision_on,committee,minute_ref,rationale from decisions where cycle_id=$1 order by decision_on,code
